questionnaire.title: ESG & Sustainability Leadership Candidate Profile
questionnaire.description: Sustainability and ESG leadership competencies for CSOs, Heads of ESG, Sustainability Managers, and ESG Controllers across all sectors. Covers carbon management, climate risk, biodiversity, social impact, ESG governance, reporting frameworks (CSRD, ISSB, GRI, TCFD, TNFD), and stakeholder engagement. Sector-agnostic design applicable to manufacturing, retail, energy, technology, healthcare, and all industries.

0.label: No Experience
0.description: No exposure or experience in this area

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands concepts; can interpret outputs; works under supervision

2.label: Practical Application
2.description: Can apply frameworks independently; works autonomously on standard tasks

3.label: Implementation & Management
3.description: Can implement, adapt and lead frameworks; designs solutions for specific contexts

4.label: Strategic Leadership
4.description: Can design from first principles; creates methodologies; enterprise-wide scope; thought leader

questionnaire.interviewNote: All self-assessed proficiency ratings will be explored during interviews. Be prepared to provide specific examples demonstrating your claimed level of expertise, particularly for reporting frameworks, decarbonisation initiatives, stakeholder engagement, and ESG governance.
